# Ezekiel 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of-man, say to the-ruler-of Tyre: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because your-heart is-lifted-up and-you-said, 'I [am] a-god; in-the-seat-of gods I-sit, in-the-heart-of the-seas' — yet-you [are] a-man and-not God, though-you-set your-heart as-the-heart-of a-god —"

**3** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning the king of Tyre and the fall from Eden, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**4** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning the king of Tyre and the fall from Eden, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**13** "In-Eden, the-garden-of God, you-were; every precious stone [was] your-covering: ruby, topaz, and-diamond, beryl, onyx, and-jasper, sapphire, turquoise, and-emerald; and-gold — the-workmanship-of your-settings and-your-engravings in-you — on-the-day you-were-created they-were-prepared."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **28:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning the king of Tyre and the fall from Eden — prophetic context established.

- **28:13**: Central imagery of pride and the guardian cherub — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **28:26**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning hubris and the downfall of Tyre's ruler.

— EMET
